newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank raises reverse repo term rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank raises reverse repo term rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it raised its term reverse repo rates following the adjustment of its key overnight rate.

The five-day reverse repo is up at 10.50 percent from 10.25 percent; one-month rrp at 11.25 percent from 10.625 percent; two-month rrp at 11.375 percent from 10.75 percent; three and six months rrp at 11.5 percent each from a previous 10.875 percent and 11.25 percent respectively.

The Central Bank increased its closely-watched overnight borrowing rate by nine percentage points yesterday to shield the peso from speculation arising from Thailand's de facto devaluation of the baht.
